components.text: Oil is the [color=yellow]base [color]for traveling in space.
You can find oil in chunk with the [ref=stellaris:items/oil_finder]Oil Finder [ref]. [br] You can then use it to create diesel fuel, which is required to power the rocket and explore space.
When you find oil in a chunk, you can extract it with a [ref=stellaris:machines/pumpjack]Pumpjack [ref].
